harnesses.name: Claude Code

hooks.inject: UserPromptSubmit/SessionStart: hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext; Stop: {"decision":"block","reason":...} continues the turn with the reason
hooks.per_launch: --settings layer (bp already passes one to the sessions it launches)

harnesses.push: none for a local TUI session (Remote Control links a claude.ai session; channels are research preview)

compaction.auto: on by default near the context limit
compaction.event: PreCompact hook; SessionStart hook with source=compact afterwards

screen.busy: spinner row above the composer: one symbol glyph, one word ending in an ellipsis, optional (timer ...) counter; none while a long answer streams
screen.idle: bordered composer box with the agent name in the top border; footer below shows -- INSERT -- / bypass permissions
screen.paste: bracketed paste; large or multi-line pastes become [Pasted text #N +M lines]; trailing image paths turn into [Image #N]
screen.dialogs: Enter to select · Esc to cancel footers; trust and resume pickers at start-up

harnesses.usage: status line JSON (context_window, current_usage); assistant message.usage in the transcript; /context, /cost
harnesses.terms: Consumer subscription use is governed by Anthropic's Consumer Terms and usage policy; automated or programmatic access is meant for the API / Agent SDK. bp drives the user's own interactive client at human-like turn boundaries and never shares credentials.

B1-receive-at-turn-boundary.note: Stop and UserPromptSubmit hooks claim queued messages; the terminal path covers an agent idle between turns

B2-never-interrupt-busy-turn.note: busy spinner + transcript TurnOpen probe; hooks run only at boundaries

B3-confirm-delivery.note: hook claims close as delivered (hook); pastes are confirmed by the transcript witness

B4-survive-compaction.note: queue and spool are on disk; SessionStart(source=compact) carries queued messages

B5-resume-after-restart.note: bp open --resume follows customTitle and continued-in chains

sources: real claude -p run with Stop/UserPromptSubmit hooks, 2026-10-09

harnesses.name: Codex CLI
harnesses.login: ChatGPT account OAuth (codex login) or OPENAI_API_KEY

hooks.config: ~/.codex/hooks.json, <repo>/.codex/hooks.json (trusted projects), [hooks] in config.toml, plugin hooks/hooks.json; on by default; each hook needs persisted trust (/hooks) or --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust
hooks.inject: Claude-compatible: additionalContext from SessionStart (source startup|resume|clear|compact), UserPromptSubmit, Pre/PostToolUse; Stop {"decision":"block","reason":...} continues the turn; PostCompact cannot inject

harnesses.push: app-server JSON-RPC (codex app-server; turn/start on a thread); codex queue --thread <id> --message <text> (app-server thread/queue/add; runs after the current turn; an unloaded thread waits until resumed)

screen.busy: • Working (Ns • esc to interrupt) row above the composer; busy composer footer 'tab to queue message'
screen.idle: › Ask Codex ... placeholder; footer '<model> <effort> · /abs/cwd' in every state
screen.paste: bracketed paste; >~1024 chars become [Pasted Content N chars]; first Enter expands, second submits
screen.submit: Enter when idle; Tab queues into Codex's own queue while busy
screen.dialogs: trust modal, start-up navigation menu, / and ? search prompts

harnesses.terms: ChatGPT plan usage is governed by OpenAI's Terms of Use and usage policies; programmatic use is offered through codex exec, the SDK and app-server.

B1-receive-at-turn-boundary.note: paste at boundary; Tab into the native queue when busy; app-server for remote threads

B2-never-interrupt-busy-turn.note: Working row + app-server status + rollout turn state

B4-survive-compaction.note: queue is on disk and rollouts are append-only so the witness survives; no identity restatement yet

B8-identity-after-compaction.note: PostCompact / SessionStart hooks or a queued identity note after a compacted record

harnesses.name: Hermes Agent
harnesses.login: provider API keys or OAuth per provider (hermes model / hermes login)

hooks.inject: pre_llm_call: stdout {"context": "..."} is appended to the turn's user message; pre_verify: {"decision":"block","reason":...} keeps the agent going (only when code was edited)
hooks.per_launch: none: hooks live in config.yaml and need first-use consent (--accept-hooks / HERMES_ACCEPT_HOOKS=1)

harnesses.push: ACP server (hermes acp); API server and webhooks (gateway); plugins can ctx.inject_message

compaction.auto: context compression before each turn when near the limit
markers: compression rotates the session id (parent_session_id chain)

screen.busy: ⚕ in front of the prompt marker (⚕ ❯ msg=interrupt · /queue · /bg · /steer)
screen.idle: ❯ Ask anything, or type / for commands…
screen.submit: Enter; Enter on a busy pane interrupts the turn
screen.dialogs: ⚠ ❯ composer and 'to select ... to confirm' hints

harnesses.usage: session_model_usage table; status row shows context percent
harnesses.instructions: AGENTS.md / SOUL.md / .hermes.md context files; skills in ~/.hermes/skills

B1-receive-at-turn-boundary.note: paste only when the caduceus is absent

B2-never-interrupt-busy-turn.note: busy Hermes refuses even forced delivery (Enter would cancel the turn)

B3-confirm-delivery.note: no transcript reader (SQLite); deliveries stay unverified

B4-survive-compaction.note: queue is on disk; compaction is not observed

B8-identity-after-compaction.note: compaction-hooks module (opt-in, off by default): a pre_llm_call shell hook restates identity on the first turn of a session with a parent_session_id (a compression fork); in-place compression (no rotation) has no signal a shell hook can see

sources: hermes_state.py (parent_session_id set on a compression fork)
